## Safety checklist (delete this section for docs-only changes)

- [ ] Nothing new can be deleted without the user ticking it and confirming.
- [ ] New or changed paths go through the existing guard (`actions.guard`).
- [ ] Personal photos, videos and documents are never suggested as "Safe".
- [ ] Every new suggestion has a plain-language reason.

## Testing

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passes
- [ ] Tried it in the app (Preview only is fine) on Windows 10 or 11
